name: Debug machine learning implementations and resolve training errors
description: Users asked for assistance in debugging and fixing errors in machine learning code, often involving specific runtime exceptions during model training, data preprocessing, or inference. The requests focused on resolving issues within scripts for various neural network architectures using libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and scikit-learn, with an emphasis on making the models run successfully and produce expected results.
